posts.author: K-apple
posts.body: I had something like this for MV but I don't know if it will work on MZ, I also lost the code itself. Basically it added a few frames of delay for skill animations. So if you used a skill that targeted multiple people it wouldn't all play at the same time but in a sequential order. This is just for an aesthetic I like for my rpg. If anyone knows a code for that or knows a plugin that allows for it, that be a big help and I appreciate it.

posts.author: Kenen
posts.body: MZ adds a 12 frame delay between single-target animations that affect multiple targets. If you aren't seeing it, you're probably using a plugin that overrides that behavior.
